items.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: How different would it have been with Bernard Purdie as opposed to say Steve Gadd or Rick Marotta

ctx.x: In fact I used to say I consider myself very lucky that I made it through that week without any changes because you know with the exception of “Deacon Blues” because as I used to say there’s bodies of drummers, bass players and guitarists strewn out the door and down Santa Monica Boulevard of those who tried and failed. And you know I never understood that because obviously they were looking for something and they kept trying until they got it. But the thing they were looking for was never clear to me. How…
